mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by strong GDP growth, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as valuations become stretched and the risk of policy tightening rises, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 in this regime is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly payroll growth above 100,000 jobs indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, strong retail sales growth signals over-optimism and potential market topping, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods with strong RSAFS growth, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in this regime is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and a decline in the federal funds rate indicates a stagflationary environment where the Fed is easing despite high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.
